title: Catalog entities and bridge definitions missing from primary grouping

x-service-invariants: reverses_event_ref is optional, nullable, server-generated and read-only; client commands and write DTOs must not accept it. The original AccountingEvent is never updated; only the new full-reversal event holds the single original-event reference.

Same-organization, authorization, original-version, posting-period, dependency and complete-reversal uniqueness checks are service and persistence responsibilities, not constraints enforced by this schema or its readOnly annotation.
Legacy rows without an AccountingEvent use the legacy adapter and original reversal service; never synthesize historical events.
Legacy rows stay physically unchanged; adapter projects original project scope/cents. legacy_project cash is registered historical project cash, never a verified bank balance.
New bank cash uses funding_account scope once; project attribution is cash allocation, not another cash posting.
Company cost sums all cost scopes once; allocation posts equal/opposite scope shifts with net company zero.

Keep actual baseline book codes cost/cash_in/cash_out and original signed amounts, including reversal negatives. Net cash = sum(cash_in) - sum(cash_out); never change old stored book/sign or invent AccountingEvent for old rows.
